name: Cable Lying Curl
steps: Position a flat bench with its head end toward a pulley set above the bench.
Lie face up and hold the cable bar above your chest with your palms turned toward you.
Keep your upper arms raised as you bend your elbows to bring the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to guide the bar back above your chest.
tips: Keep your upper arms steady as your forearms move.
Keep your wrists aligned with your forearms as you control the return.
